name.ja: 計測: 買った品が棚に戻る道

description.en: Records where a bought item comes back onto the shop's shelf (answered: shopping_start_method_1 rebuilds it from the goods template when the shop opens). Items born during a shop scene with id, obtainer, attributes and the game-side caller; the shop path boundaries (ShoppingStartManagerRemake.execute / shopping_start_method_1 / toggle_twin_inventory_window / buy_item / sell_item / close_shopping_window_process, and the generators inside a shop scene) as the keys added to and removed from both inventories; the goods template summary and index['item']. Read-only
description.ja: 買った品が店の棚へ戻るのがどこかを録る（決着: 店を開いたときに shopping_start_method_1 が雛形から作り直す）。店の場面の中で生まれた品の id・持ち主・attributes とゲーム側の呼び出し元、店の経路の境目（ShoppingStartManagerRemake.execute / shopping_start_method_1 / toggle_twin_inventory_window / buy_item / sell_item / close_shopping_window_process と、店の場面の中の生成の入口）ごとの主と手持ちの鍵の増減、品揃えの雛形の要約と採番台帳 index['item']。読み取りだけでゲームは変えない

label.ja: 店の外で写す品の誕生の件数
label.en: New items to record outside a shop

note.ja: 店の場面の中で生まれた品は、この件数に関わらず全部写す。店の外（ロードや NPC の生成で何百も生まれる）は既定で写さない
note.en: Items born during a shop scene are always recorded; the rest (a load or npc generation creates hundreds) are not recorded by default

note.ja: 持ち物・採番台帳・品揃えの雛形のどれかが動いた呼び出しだけ数える。動いていない呼び出しは書かない
note.en: Only calls that moved an inventory, the id ledger or the goods template are counted

label.ja: 呼び出し元を遡る段数
label.en: How far back to walk the caller chain

note.ja: ローダと MOD のフレームは飛ばして、ゲーム側だけを数える
note.en: Loader and mod frames are skipped; only game frames are counted
